notes.title: New color palettes
notes.content:
Added 2 new color palettes for free jam projects made after the game.

[url=https://apehardware.itch.io/t-m-e-a]T: (M, E, A)[/url]: an apolitical coordinate-determined turn-based rpg about decolonising the Sakha Republic with shamanism and abstract violence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/864f94fe4e71cf007bb3b55b5d6012b2d739ba92.png[/img]

[url=https://apehardware.itch.io/destrozaltri]DESTROZALTRI[/url]: an apolitical bullet hell boss rush about destroying the Altri  company and burning down their pulp factory project in Galicia, with links to a real protest movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/4da6ff6523128653a7cf2007a77d6b5f3d8fa1ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added D-Pad support for movement controls.
[*](Hopefully) Fixed the palette menu not unlocking earlier games.
[*]Changed the trigger warning text to make clear that the game [i]mentions[/i] generative AI, but does not [i]use[/i] it.
[/list]
